background.with.label: With background
background.with.title: The background as in the preview
background.transparent.label: Transparent
background.transparent.title: No background: the recording, the camera and everything over them stay; around them the video is see-through
background.overlays.label: Overlays only
background.overlays.title: Only what goes over the recording: the camera, captions, texts, images, key presses, title cards and the progress bar. No recording and no background. For laying over another video
hint.plays: Plays transparent in Chrome, Edge and Firefox (WebM), and in editing software (MOV). Safari shows WebM on black.
hint.fills: With no padding the recording fills the frame: nothing will be see-through. Add padding in Style, or choose Overlays only.
preview.name: Preview of a transparent video
